title: Finitely many fibre Hilbert functions of a finite graded module
statement: Let $S$ be a Noetherian scheme (quasi-compact and locally Noetherian [pqf-def-locnoeth, def-weil-pbc-quasi-compact-scheme]). Let $\mathcal B=\bigoplus_{d\geq0}\mathcal B_d$ be a quasi-coherent commutative graded $\mathcal O_S$-algebra [def-weil-pbc-graded-sheaf-structures, pqf-def-coherent] with $\mathcal B_0=\mathcal O_S$, generated by a coherent $\mathcal B_1$. Let $L=\bigoplus_{d\geq0}L_d$ be a graded $\mathcal B$-module with quasi-coherent homogeneous pieces, locally generated over $\mathcal B$ by finitely many homogeneous sections (their degrees need not be zero). Then each $L_d$ is coherent. For $s\in S$ let $\kappa(s)$ be its residue field [def-weil-residue-field] and set $h_s(d)=\dim_{\kappa(s)}(L_{d,s}\otimes_{\mathcal O_{S,s}}\kappa(s))$. There is a finite set $H\subseteq\mathbf N^{\mathbf N}$ such that $h_s\in H$ for every $s\in S$. The empty scheme is allowed, with $H=\varnothing$.

source.place: Tag 0ASY, lemma-generic-flatness-stratification, applied on affine charts to the sheaf of the finite graded module on Spec of its graded algebra; together with algebra.tex Tag 00K0, lemma-graded-module-fg. The finite-Hilbert-function consequence is also the initial flat-stratification argument of Bourbaki Expose 221, Lemma 3.5.

proof.text: Apply [lem-sfb-graded-affine-monomial-models] to obtain a finite affine cover with the stated finite monomial generators for each $L_d$, finite modules $M_d$, finite-type graded algebras $C$, finite graded $C$-modules $M$, and the fibre comparison. The sheaf generating lists show that each $L_d$ is of finite type. Since its quasi-coherence is assumed and $S$ is locally Noetherian, [pqf-lem-coherent-ft-locnoeth] makes it coherent.

source.place: Tag 00K0, lemma-graded-module-fg (monomial argument), adapted to sheaves; schemes.tex Tags 01HV, lemma-spec-sheaves, and 01IA, lemma-quasi-coherent-affine (sections and stalk comparison).

proof.text: Fix a chart $\operatorname{Spec}A$ from step 1. Here $A$ is Noetherian, $C_0=A$, $C$ is a finite-type graded $A$-algebra, $M$ is finite over $C$, and every $M_d$ is finite over $A$. The images of a finite generating list of $M_d$ span its residue-field fibre, so its dimension is a natural number. Define $f(\mathfrak p)(d)=\dim_{\kappa(\mathfrak p)}(M_d\otimes_A\kappa(\mathfrak p))$, a value in $\mathbf N^{\mathbf N}$. For every prime $I$, [lem-sfb-graded-quotient-generic-ranks] supplies $0\ne a\in A/I$ and one function $r$ on $\operatorname{Spec}(A/I)_a$. Its stated fibre isomorphisms identify these values with $f$ on $V(I)\cap D(b)$, where $b\notin I$ is a lift of $a$. Thus $f=r$ on that principal open, simultaneously in all degrees.

source.place: Tag 051R, lemma-generic-flatness-Noetherian, and Tag 00NX, lemma-finite-projective, clauses (3) and (8); graded direct-summand and quotient/localization fibre adaptation of the item proof steps 4--6.

proof.text: Apply [lem-sfb-noetherian-generically-constant-finite-image] with $T=\mathbf N^{\mathbf N}$ and this $f$. The principal-open hypothesis is precisely step 2 for every prime $I$, and $A$ is Noetherian by step 1. Hence the image $H_U=f(\operatorname{Spec}A)$ is finite.

source.place: Tag 0ASY, lemma-generic-flatness-stratification, Noetherian-induction pattern; algebra.tex Tags 00IK, lemma-Noetherian-basic, and 00FR, lemma-Noetherian-irreducible-components; abstract finite-image adaptation of the item proof steps 3 and 6.

proof.text: Let $H$ be the union of the $H_U$ over the finite affine cover. It is finite, and each $h_s$ belongs to it by the fibre comparison of step 1. If $S$ is empty use the empty cover and $H=\varnothing$. Empty generator lists, generators in degrees larger than $d$, and zero modules are already allowed by the affine-model statement.

source.place: Tag 0ASY, finite-stratification consequence; finite union over an affine cover
